newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH STOCKS RISE IN LIVE TRADE, DEFY MAIN MKT.
newsitem.headline: POLISH STOCKS RISE IN LIVE TRADE, DEFY MAIN MKT.

text.p: Animex , Budimex, Elektrim, Stalexport and Universal closed higher in Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Tuesday.
Turnover rose to 2.7 million zlotys from 1.1 million zlotys on Monday.
BIG and Okocim closed flat and the remaining eight stocks did not trade.
NFI units rose to 138 zlotys in a 19.4-million- zloty turnover.
The continuous trading system, which currently lists 15 companies, is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 65 others are traded.
At the single-price auction session most stocks fell and the main market's index was down 2.1 percent.
